notes: This is a lattice QCD paper computing the equation of state and the topological susceptibility chi(T) of QCD. Its only axion-related result is a cosmological PREDICTION of the QCD dark-matter axion MASS in the post-inflation misalignment scenario: m_A = 50-1500 microeV (Fig. 3, with chi(T=0) = [75.6 MeV]^4 in Fig. 2). It does not report any experimental or observational exclusion limit on any axion or dark-photon COUPLING (no g_agamma, g_ae, g_an, g_d, etc.). No canonical coupling curve exists to extract. is_new_limit=false. It is a mass prediction, not an experimental sensitivity projection either, so is_projection=false. coupling_convention field left as the schema default placeholder since no coupling is reported.
